vectors.name: empty-project
vectors.description: A project with no Pulse entries and no sessions is a complete, confirmed-empty digest - never a partial read.

vectors.name: same-author-supersession-chain
vectors.description: Single-pass marking, never a traversal: each link marks exactly its own target, so only the newest entry stays active and every predecessor is returned with active:false and its honored claim recorded.

vectors.name: cross-author-supersession-not-honored
vectors.description: A supersedes across authors never removes its target: Alice's blocker stays active and Bob's entry carries the unhonored claim. Without this, any project writer could push a peer's blocker out of the set that drives wait|consult|proceed.

vectors.name: unresolved-supersedes
vectors.description: A reference to an id outside the fetched result set leaves the target unknown and the entry active; the claim is echoed verbatim as unresolved and recorded in errors[]. An unresolved reference is not a failed read, so complete stays true.

entries.text: Continuing from an entry outside this window.

vectors.name: created-at-tie-greater-id-honored
vectors.description: Nostr timestamps have one-second precision, so a tie is broken by the greater event id - the same (created_at, event id) fold the coding-session closure uses.

events.content: {"schema":"buzz-pulse-entry/v1","type":"note","text":"First of two entries at the same second.","codeAreas":[],"branch":null,"supersedes":null}

entries.text: First of two entries at the same second.

vectors.name: created-at-tie-lesser-id-not-honored
vectors.description: The mirror of the tie rule: a claimant that loses the tie does not supersede, so the ordering is total and no two entries can supersede each other.

vectors.name: two-entries-supersede-one-target
vectors.description: Marking is per-claim, not per-target: both revisions are honored and both are recorded on the target, which is returned once with active:false.

entries.text: Second revision, also naming the original.

vectors.name: self-referencing-entry-excluded
vectors.description: An entry whose supersedes is its own id fails validation (buzz-core rejects it at ingest, so only a smuggled event reaches a reader). It is excluded from entries[] and recorded in errors[] - never dropped silently, and never counted as a valid claim.

vectors.name: session-null-observations-preserved
vectors.description: Unknown is not false: a probe that did not run leaves observedCommit/dirty/relayReachable/verifiedAt null, and every null survives the fold. observedAgeSeconds comes from the 44223 created_at, never from verifiedAt.

events.content: Ship explicit Pulse end to end.

vectors.name: closed-session-is-not-active-work
vectors.description: A closed umbrella fails clause (a) of the Active-work rule even with a fresh running status. It stays in sessions[] with closed:true and activity 'stale' - closed history is disclosed, never deleted, and never presented as somebody currently working.

vectors.name: freshness-window-and-commit-confirmation
vectors.description: Active work needs a positive freshness signal. An observation exactly PULSE_ACTIVE_WINDOW old is still active; one second older is stale; and a fresh 'disconnected' status is stale regardless of age - the orphaned execution renders under Last seen and must never contribute a wait. The three commitConfirmation strings are pinned here.

vectors.name: no-branch-rows-preserved
vectors.description: A null branch is its own group, never merged into a named branch and never rendered as one. The fold preserves null; the --branch - filter and Desktop's 'no branch' chip select on it.

vectors.name: branch-tag-without-content-branch
vectors.description: The envelope validator accepts a `branch` tag alongside a null content branch (it only rejects a mismatch), so this shape is valid on the wire. Both folds must derive the entry's branch the same way: content field first, then the `branch` tag. Without this vector the two folds can disagree - one filing the entry under `wip/x`, the other under 'no branch' - while every other vector stays green.

vectors.name: partial-read-is-never-an-empty-digest
vectors.description: complete:false plus a non-empty errors[] is the only representation of a partial read. A source query that failed must never render as a quiet project - the caller exits 2 on this digest.

entries.text: The one entry the reader could see.

vectors.name: foreign-project-entry-is-never-an-error
vectors.description: Project scope is decided before envelope validation. A 44240 tagged with a DIFFERENT project is not this digest's business - a mixed result set is a caller's shape, not a defect - so it is skipped silently even when its own envelope is malformed, and it never appears in errors[]. Only an entry whose coordinate cannot be resolved at all is recorded as invalid.

vectors.name: session-identity-comes-from-content-not-the-cs-target-tag
vectors.description: The session's targetKey is derived from the 44223 content `session` object, byte-identical to coding_session_target_key. The cs-target tag is a filter affordance that nothing validates for a 44223, so a tag disagreeing with the content does not move the identity, and an event with no cs-target tag at all is still folded.
